description_en: Queries whether Anti-DDoS Proxy are authorized to access other cloud services
description_zh: 查询是否授权DDoS高防服务访问其他云产品
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-sts-grant-status --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --role AliyunDDoSCOODefaultRole --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeStsGrantStatus

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default resource group is used.
parameters.description_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。

parameters.description_en:
The name of the RAM role that you want to query. The value is fixed as **AliyunDDoSCOODefaultRole**, which indicates the default role of Anti-DDoS Proxy.

> Anti-DDoS Proxy use this role by default to access your resources in other cloud services.
parameters.description_zh:
要查询的RAM角色名称。取值固定为**AliyunDDoSCOODefaultRole**，表示DDoS高防服务的默认角色。

> DDoS高防服务默认使用此角色来访问您在其他云产品中的资源。
